messages:
emma-partnerships: Quick sync — LockForge (HSM vendor) and CipherWorks (SI) want a joint marketplace listing + integration pilot for Redwood Private. Scope: SSO/SAML, SCIM user provisioning, and KMS/HSM key-wrap path for customer-managed keys. Aim: pilot by EOY. Who can own tech integration vs. go-to-market?

josh-sales: I'll own GTM + contract terms. Need compliant SLAs and joint PR. Do we have templated co-sell assets?

sara-product: We need a product checklist. I'll own marketplace listing metadata. Need logos, cert statements, supported regions, and a recommended deployment topology.

rahul-eng: Tech questions: does LockForge expose a KMIP or REST KMS? Need sample API and TLS mutual auth. Also SCIM endpoints + SAML IdP metadata from CipherWorks. Will we surface KMS through our Private KMS connector.

alex-ops: For Private we'd need VPC peering + egress rules to LockForge mgmt endpoints. Also HSM is likely air-gapped for some customers — note network constraints.

emma-partnerships: LockForge prefers KMIP over TLS. CipherWorks can front SCIM + SAML as an integrator. They asked for an approved connector reference and a "how-to" doc. Can we draft a minimal runbook?

rahul-eng: Draft runbook snippet below (for eng review): 
``` 
# KMS connector pseudo-config
kms_vendor: lockforge
endpoint: https://kms.lockforge.example:8443
auth: mTLS (client cert)
key_wrapping: kmip-wrap
```
Also SCIM sample:
```
SCIM_BASE=https://cipherworks-scim.example/api/v2
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

sara-product: Nice. Add note about SCIM attrs we need: userName, emails, externalId, groups. We'll include a field mapping doc.

josh-sales: Timeline check — partner legal wants a co-marketing slot week-of-12/18. Is pilot readiness realistic by then?

alex-ops: If we can get certs and a test VM, yes. Ops can stand up a staging peering this week if firewall rules are provided.

emma-partnerships: Action items:
- josh -> finalize commercial/press timeline (by 11/10)
- sara -> marketplace metadata + mapping doc (by 11/17)
- rahul -> prototype KMS connector + runbook (by 11/20)
- alex -> staging network template + peering checklist (by 11/15)
I'll follow up with LockForge/CipherWorks today and post their assets to the partner drive.

onboard-bot: Partnership created: LockForge + CipherWorks joint listing. Tracker: https://redwood.internal/partners/LOCKFORGE-CIPHERWORKS (expires in 90d)

sara-product: :thumbsup: added task cards in product board.

rahul-eng: Will ping if we need a cust test key. If anyone has vendor test certs drop here.

josh-sales: I'll coordinate the press / co-sell brief once legal signs off.

emma-partnerships: Great — sync weekly Friday 10am starting tomorrow. Thanks!
